Application.Text1:
units:
unit_id: U001
kind: design
claim: Five clearing temperatures compare transparency and GFP fluorescence; morphology and labeling comparisons focus on 37/42/47°C.
source_locator: Results overview; Fig1–5
condition_binding: S1/S2; clearing only
values: 
  temperature_C: 
    [1] 37
    [2] 42
    [3] 47
    [4] 52
    [5] 57

Application.Text2:
units:
unit_id: U002
kind: preparation
claim: Fixed adult brain blocks form A4P0 hydrogel hybrids before temperature comparison.
source_locator: Methods Preparation of mouse brain blocks; PACT clearing protocol
condition_binding: S1/S2
values: 
  postfixation: 4% PFA overnight 4°C
  infiltration: A4P0 overnight 4°C
  degassing: nitrogen 5–10 min
  polymerization: 3 h at37°C
  clearing_solution: 8% SDS
  A4P0_composition: named formulation, not locally fully restated

Application.Text3:
units:
unit_id: U003
kind: time
claim: Photographic endpoints and graph clearing-time means are different evidence types; temperature-specific clearing times must not be replaced by one universal protocol duration.
source_locator: Fig1a,b; Methods Selection of clearing temperature
condition_binding: S1 1mm, SDS
values: 
  photo_time_h: 
    [1] 0
    [2] 12
    [3] 24
    [4] 36
    [5] 48
  last_photo_h_by_C: 
    37: 48
    42: 36
    47: 24
    52: 24
    57: 12
  graph_means: bar-height estimates only; exact numerical means not tabulated

Application.Text4:
units:
unit_id: U004
kind: result
claim: At equal 6h SDS exposure, relative collimated transmittance increases with clearing temperature; sorbitol adds a separate RI-matching improvement.
source_locator: Results Optical transparency; Supplementary Fig1
condition_binding: 1mm half-brain;500nm
values: 
  temperature_C: 
    [1] 37
    [2] 42
    [3] 47
    [4] 52
    [5] 57
  SDS_6h_percent: 
    [1] 5.5
    [2] 10.4
    [3] 18.9
    [4] 30.3
    [5] 57.9
  SDS_6h_then_sorbitol_percent: 
    [1] 32.5
    [2] 45.2
    [3] 58.6
    [4] 69.2
    [5] 86.5

Application.Text5:
units:
unit_id: U005
kind: measurement
claim: Transmittance is normalized to a blank=100%, measured with 3×3mm slit across400–800nm; it is not broadband bulk transparency or attenuation-free imaging.
source_locator: Methods Measurement of transmittance; Supplementary Fig1
condition_binding: 1mm half-brain spectral collimated transmission
values: 
{}

Application.Text6:
units:
unit_id: U006
kind: result
claim: Mean GFP intensity falls at every tested temperature at cleared endpoints, whereas expansion-adjusted total fluorescence at42/47°C is comparable with37°C;52/57°C are markedly reduced.
source_locator: Results Fluorescence preservation; Fig2
condition_binding: S1,50µm maximum projections, matched imaging conditions
values: 
  text_total_ratio_42: 1.18
  text_SD_42: 0.11
  text_total_ratio_47: 1.08
  text_SD_47: 0.17
  Fig2_significance: 52/57°C **P<.01;42/47 n.s.

Application.Text7:
units:
unit_id: U007
kind: measurement
claim: Mean intensity times selected neuronal soma area defines total intensity; per-neuron after/before ratio B/A averaged across25 neurons per group. This is not protein mass retention or independent25-animal replication.
source_locator: Methods Image analysis
condition_binding: S1 fluorescence
values: 
  neurons_per_group: 25
  animals_per_group: null (as recorded in source)
  total_measure: intensity×2D soma area

Application.Text8:
units:
unit_id: U008
kind: result
claim: Equal prolonged exposure differs from endpoint comparisons:42°C does not differ significantly from37°C across48h,47°C differs,52/57°C show larger decline.
source_locator: Supplementary Fig2; main Results fluorescence
condition_binding: S1 timecourse
values: 
  times_h: 
    [1] 0
    [2] 12
    [3] 24
    [4] 36
    [5] 48
  error_type: SEM
  test: mixed-design two-way ANOVA
  S2_47_vs37: *P<.05
  S2_52_57_vs37: ***P<.001

Application.Text9:
units:
unit_id: U009
kind: result
claim: Imaging depth is contrast decay to1/e of maximum/surface contrast, not deepest visible structure.
source_locator: Fig3; Methods Image analysis; equation1
condition_binding: S2 microglia
values: 
  formula: sqrt(sum((I-Imean)^2)/(n-1))
  normalization: contrast profile normalized; imaging depth threshold1/e

unit_id: U010
kind: time
claim: 1mm depth specimens use6h or12h SDS at37/42/47°C, then PBST rinse and70%wt/vol sorbitol5h.
source_locator: Methods Selection of clearing temperature; Fig3
condition_binding: S2 1mm depth experiment
values: 
  SDS_h: 
    [1] 6
    [2] 12
  sorbitol_h: 5
  temperature_C: 
    [1] 37
    [2] 42
    [3] 47

unit_id: U011
kind: result
claim: Depth rises with time and temperature in1mm sections; plotted values are relative depth (uncleared=100%), not absolute µm at every bar.
source_locator: Fig3b

values:

source_locator: Fig5; Discussion immunostaining
condition_binding: S1 1mm;temperature-specific cleared endpoints;5h sorbitol

      [2] 200

unit_id: U019

unit_id: U020
kind: result
claim: YFP declines with elevated temperature; the GFP compromise cannot be generalized to YFP, all fluorophores or all tissues.

claim: Micelle-size changes and alkaline fluorescence enhancement are author explanations, not direct measurements of micelle number, protein loss or hybrid ultrastructure.

units:

kind: limitation
claim: SDS residue before sorbitol can cause whitening and reduced transparency; no optimized rinse schedule is invented.

units:

claim: Authors propose lower temperature for thicker/longer exposures and broader passive-method applications; those extensions are recommendations/hypotheses, not validation in all tissues.

Application.Text25:
findings:
Independently read Methods [23]: imaging-depth tests limited to 37/42/47 C, not five-temperature series.

Application.Text26:
findings:
Independently read Methods [27] and Results [8], viewed Fig2 and S6. Per-neuron B/A and mean intensity times area are distinct from unexplained plotted normalization; do not infer absolute protein retention or missing denominator.

Application.Text27:
findings:
Independently viewed S2: 47 C versus37 C single-star P<0.05, 52/57 triple-star P<0.001, 42 nonsignificant not equivalence. Endpoint and fixed-duration remain distinct.
